parameters.name: Ipv4s
parameters.description: An array of IPv4 address ranges for the custom line. Specify each range in the `StartIP-EndIP` format.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: `en` and `zh`. Default value: `en`.

parameters.name: LineId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the custom line.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the custom line.
